open_questions: A fresh process holds TLS indices 0 and 16 before the program's first TlsAlloc (row tls.alloc.many.indices on every run); which component holds them is not observed.
FlsGetValue answers ERROR_INVALID_PARAMETER for an allocated index until the thread's first FlsSetValue (rows fls.get.fresh, fls.get.after_set).

sections.excluded: fls.free.with_callback: FlsFree runs the index's callback in the program's code; w2m cannot yet call into guest code from the runtime and stops there (Sprint 047, with threads, whose exits run FLS callbacks too). The probe writes its other rows first.
